description_en: Queries the O&M task configuration of an instance
description_zh: 查询实例的运维任务配置
name: DescribeActiveOperationMaintenanceConfig

Config.description_en: The configuration details of the O&M task
Config.description_zh: 运维任务的配置详情信息

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the O&M task configuration was created. The time is in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建运维任务配置的时间点，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ （utc时间）

CycleTime.description_en:
The cycle time.

If CycleType is set to Month, a number from 1 to 28 is returned, indicating the day of the month. Multiple values are separated by commas (,). The value is 0 if the configuration is inactive.
If CycleType is set to Week, a number from 1 to 7 is returned, indicating the day of the week. Multiple values are separated by commas (,). The value is 0 if the configuration is inactive
CycleTime.description_zh:
周期时间。

当CycleType为Month，返回1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。配置未生效时为0。
当CycleType为Week，返回1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接。配置未生效时为0

CycleType.description_en:
The cycle type. Valid values:

Month: monthly
Week: weekly
CycleType.description_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the O&M time window. The time is in the hh:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 运维时间窗口结束时间，格式为hh:mm:ssZ (utc时间)

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the O&M time window. The time is in the hh:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 运维时间窗口开始时间，格式为hh:mm:ssZ (utc时间)

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the O&M task configuration was last modified. The time is in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 上一次修改运维任务配置的时间点，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ （utc时间）

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the configuration is active. Valid values:

1: Active.
2: Inactive
Status.description_zh:
配置是否生效。

1 生效
2 无效

HasConfig.description_en:
Indicates whether the configuration exists. Valid values:

1: Configured.
0: Not configured
HasConfig.description_zh:
是否已配置：

1：已经配置；
0：未配置
